lines:
Responsibilities: Is the worker's sole process-boundary adapter to the Trusted Application Core. It receives generation-fenced controls and committed outcomes, and sends normalized lifecycle/context/evidence/checkpoint proposals plus InvocationProposalV1 requests. No other worker module talks to core services or the Capability Host directly.
Owned runtime state: negotiated protocol version, authenticated worker/run generation, snapshot identity, inbound committed cursor, outbound worker sequence, stable proposal IDs, bounded unacknowledged proposal buffer, heartbeat state, and per-stream backpressure windows. These are delivery mechanics, not canonical history.
Input/output DTOs and ports: receives WorkerControlEnvelopeV1, CapabilityOutcomeV1, ApprovalOutcomeV1, InputDeliveryV1, CoreCommittedAckV1, and RehydrationEnvelopeV1; sends ReadyV1, WorkerProposalEnvelopeV1, InvocationProposalV1, CheckpointProposalV1, HealthV1, QuiescedV1, and RehydrationReadyV1 or RehydrationBlockedV1.
Algorithms and invariants: validates frame size, schema version, run, generation, snapshot, attempt, and contiguous committed cursor before delivery. Transport acceptance never means a proposal is committed. The acknowledged cursor advances only from a core durable-commit acknowledgement. Safe proposal retransmission uses the same proposal ID; it never repeats a capability effect. Invocation requests carry only opaque authority, capability, budget, attempt, and credential-reference metadata for the broker. The worker never receives secret values and has no channel to aworkit.capability_host.
Failure, cancellation, and recovery: malformed or cross-generation frames fail closed. Backpressure quiesces new effect-producing admissions before memory becomes unbounded. Disconnect preserves the bounded proposal buffer and stops assuming progress; replacement generations recover from core state. Cancellation and heartbeats use reserved control capacity so streams cannot starve them.
Performance and NFRs: explicit maximum frame and in-flight sizes, CRC or authenticated local-channel framing as selected by the core, bounded memory, resumable cursors, low-latency control lanes, protocol conformance fixtures, and structured diagnostics without secrets.
Normative semantic proposal transport: WorkerProposalEnvelopeV1 carries stable proposalId, SpanId, optional ParentSpanId, SpanKind, optional causation proposal/event identity, semantic event kind, and normalized redacted payload or artifact reference. The gateway preserves proposal order and backpressure boundaries from scheduler/model-agent; retransmission reuses proposalId. Transport acceptance is never live UI visibility. Only CoreCommittedAckV1 advances the acknowledged semantic cursor, after the trusted core has durably committed and assigned EventId/Chat sequence. The gateway must not send provider fragments as canonical events or maintain a second live-event sequence.

Non-responsibilities: no authority or approval, secret brokerage, host/provider/tool execution, process supervision, canonical event commit, workflow policy, or side-effect replay.

data.name: Trusted Core IPC & Proposal Gateway
data.technology: Rust versioned length-delimited framed IPC with bounded async channels
